basis: Market-anchored retail for Switzerland/EU — set to what art and literary prints and merchandise actually sell for, not cost-plus (cost-plus on print-on-demand underprices art). The margin shown is retail minus an APPROXIMATE supplier base cost and is a floor: it holds at any plausible base cost.
verify: Exact base costs must be read from the Gelato / Printful dashboard at setup — both hide per-item cost behind a logged-in calculator, so the approxBase figures here are industry ballparks to confirm, not quotes.
shippingCH: Printful to Switzerland (printful.com/shipping, fetched 2026-10-20): roughly CHF 4.5–10 for the first item plus ~CHF 1–2 per extra item (EFTA rate is the closest Swiss match, unconfirmed). Charged on top of the item price, or absorbed into a free-shipping threshold. Verify at checkout.
feesNote: Retail is before shipping and before platform/payment fees (card ~2.9% + fixed; Printful premium placement ~USD 1). Keep a few CHF of headroom for these.
resolutionNote: The master is 7200 px on the long side = 24 in at 300 DPI. 30×40 cm prints at ~450 DPI, 50×70 at ~260 DPI, 61×91 cm (24×36 in) at ~200 DPI (large wall poster, viewed at a distance). The cushion is offered only for the square works; other products fit any aspect (the platform places each work in the matching orientation at listing time).
